page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i2g.16xlarge is an x86_64 server powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs derived from 32 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The instance is equipped with 256 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. A key hardware feature is the inclusion of 7679 GB of local SSD storage, alongside a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates a clear division between single-core and multi-core capabilities. Single-core performance is weak, as shown by stress-ng and Geekbench single-core scores falling into the bottom 25%, and a poor single-threaded gzip compression result in the bottom 10%. However, the 64-vCPU configuration delivers average multi-core performance in stress-ng and Geekbench tests. Multi-threaded bzip3 decompression is a notable strength, ranking in the top 25%. Memory bandwidth and database operations, including Redis SET and Passmark database tests, perform in the average tier.

From a resource density perspective, this server offers a high volume of local SSD storage bundled directly with a significant vCPU count, making it qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads requiring large local data footprints without the overhead of external storage. The primary tradeoff is the lower single-threaded processing speed, which limits its suitability for single-core bottlenecked tasks. It is best suited for multi-threaded workloads, local database hosting, distributed data processing, and static web serving where high storage capacity and parallel execution are required.
